The all-India volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population
went up to 17-87 in 1981 in to}l7 -62 in 1980. For the States
as a whole it was 17-54 in 1981 as against 17-42 in 1980. For the
Union as a whole it was 40-72 in 1981 as against 31 -30
in 1980. Data from only 8 metropolitan cities was collected for the
year 1980. But for the year 1981, four more cities viz. Jaipur, Luck-
now, Nagpur and Pune were also added and for the twelve Me-
tropolitan Cities taken together the volume of accidental deaths per
lakh of population was 54-83 in 1981 as against 38 -00 for 8 Méetro-
politan cities taken together in 1980. Thus the volume of accidental
deaths per lakh of ponulation went up for the country as well as for
the States, Union and Metropolitan Cities as a whole in
1981 in comparison to 1980. In 1981, the all-India figures, and the
figures for the States, Union Territories and Metropolitan cities were
more than the figures of 1980.
